liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): Bobby plays funky guitar on this opener; Opens after about 222 seconds of nervous crowd noise; Jerry's lead vocal is thin while Brent sounds eager [11][15][19]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds the Scarlet-Fire pairing amazing; The Scarlet-Fire runs about 33 minutes, which the reviewer calls rare [13][20]
- **Brokedown Palace** (2 reviews): Described as crushing, alongside Stella Blue; The Satisfaction-into-Brokedown Palace finish is described as moving [12][13]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Described as crushing, alongside Brokedown Palace [12]
- **TLEO** (1 review): Bobby's guitar work is compelling here, including notable harmonics [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1982-05-23.167340.shure.sm57.kelley.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 198 min [1]
- **gd82-05-23.sbd.gorinsky.5058.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 186 min; rated 4.15/5 by 20 [4]. Said about its sound: Older soundboard copy was cut-up, hissy and high-generation; Bobby's guitar sits far forward in the mix; Bobby is rather high in the mix, giving rhythmic counterpoint to Jerry [11][15]
- **gd1982-05-23.156111.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 183 min [6]
- **gd1982-05-23.167339.shure.sm57.kelley.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 23 songs; 198 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls the show as a solid effort, with a between-set anecdote involving Steely Dan's Hey Nineteen playing [17]
- Hells Angels were backstage in force; one idling and revving a motorcycle can be heard during drums [18]
- Sunny May day; a keg was behind a science building nearby; the second set felt very long [18]
- Six songs before drums in the second set plus a double encore [20]
- Reviewer says another commenter's timings are off by about a third, due to VBR MP3 file sizes [21]
- A Harley Davidson motorcycle was miked during drums [1]
- A Harley Davidson motorcycle was miked during drums [3]
- A Harley Davidson motorcycle was miked during drums [6]
- Reviewer says this show is less reviewed than the night before and the April 17-19 run, and less heady than the previous night [16]
- Reviewer begins comparing 1982 to other years, regarding Jerry's voice [19]
- Reviewer thinks the pre-drums second set segment is the longest of 1982 [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1982-05-23.167340.shure.sm57.kelley.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Ken Kelley; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Ken Kelley's Master Audience Cassettes; Shure SM57 mics > JVC KD-2 w/Super ANRS (Maxell XLII-S90) [1]
- **gd82-05-23.sbd.gorinsky.5058.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Reviewer's earlier Dead Hour copy had Sublime recorded over the second set [13]
- **gd1982-05-23.156111.senn421.vita.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5 > Jim Vita's 1st generation cassettes (Maxell UDXL-IIS 90) [6]. Also: Bob Wagner's Nakamichi 700 source patches the Eyes jam, start of Satisfaction and end of Brokedown Palace [6]
- **gd1982-05-23.167339.shure.sm57.kelley.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ken Kelley; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Ken Kelley's Master Audience Cassettes; Shure SM57 mics > JVC KD-2 w/Super ANRS (Maxell XLII-S90) [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [1982-05-22 Greek Theatre, Berkeley, CA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1982-05-22-greek-theatre-berkeley-ca/) [24]
- Fan art by arizjones.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead, The Greek Theater, Berkeley, CA. Three shows May 1982 (SBD)](https://arizjones.blogspot.com/2015/01/grateful-dead-greek-theater-berkeley-ca.html) [25]
